leadText: Magical Pokémon Journey: Swimming with the Qwilfish is the twenty-fifth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the 37th and 38th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
